daily.title: Australia could follow Canada as EU 'associate member', parliament president says
daily.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney has welcomed the prospect of Canada becoming the first "associate member" of the European Union, as the president of the European Parliament has hinted Australia and New Zealand could follow.

daily.title: Athlete Joanna Wietrzyk apologises for continuing HYROX race after soiling herself
daily.summary: The athlete who had a bout of faecal incontinence during a HYROX competition has issued a public apology and retroactively withdrawn from the race, handing back points earned in the event.

daily.title: King warns AI leaders of 'existential' risks if tech falls into wrong hands
daily.summary: Britain's King Charles III has warned AI leaders of the "existential dangers" posed by the technology falling into the wrong hands while hosting the leaders from top artificial intelligence firms.

daily.title: Smart glasses ban looms as Labor sets out new AI rules
daily.summary: Smart glasses could be prohibited in Commonwealth workplaces as the government consults on new rules for Australia's growing AI sector.

daily.title: UN-backed experts find US strike on Minab school amounts to war crime
daily.summary: A fact-finding mission on Iran, backed by the United Nations, finds Iranian citizens have been caught between crimes against humanity by their own government and deadly conflict with the US and Israel.

daily.title: Woman charged after baby found dead in Sydney bin
daily.summary: NSW Police say a 24-year-old woman "believed to be the mother of the infant" has been charged.

daily.title: Man charged with murder after alleged assault in Tasmania's north
daily.summary: A 42-year-old man has been charged with murder after allegedly assaulting a man at a house in Tasmania's north.

daily.title: Backpacker cuts slammed as 'low blow' for farming and tourism
daily.summary: Farming and tourism industry leaders say cuts to backpacker numbers will slash the available workforce across regional Australia.

daily.title: Disability advocate's tragic drowning spurs life-saving gesture
daily.summary: Ellen Fraser-Barbour's drowning at a popular swimming hole in central Australia prompts the NT's St John Ambulance service to install an automated external defibrillator at the site to commemorate her disability advocacy work.

daily.title: Grandmother says system failing despite WA child protection minister's flying visit
daily.summary: On the anniversary of her grandchildren's burial, Dorothy Papertalk is leading calls for change in South Hedland as a political firestorm grows over Western Australia's child protection failures.

daily.title: NASA scientist's chance Moon discovery reveals once-in-a-lifetime crater
daily.summary: Wider and about as deep as the Roman Colosseum, researchers believe the newly-discovered McGetchin crater was formed after a powerful surface impact in 2024.

daily.title: Netballer fined after unprecedented assault charge
daily.summary: Diamonds defender Sarah Klau is handed a $5,000 fine and a suspended two-game ban after pleading guilty to assault and failing to disclose the incident prior to the Commonwealth Games. But she'll still be eligible to play at the Constellation Cup.

daily.title: Woman who stabbed sons to death found not criminally responsible
daily.summary: The woman, who was wiping her eyes in court on Wednesday, will instead be detained at a facility determined by mental health experts.

daily.title: Politician apologises for yelling, swearing in staff meeting
daily.summary: The commissioner investigating Fiona Carrick's conduct said she had made "well-meaning" but unsuccessful attempts to bring tension down in her office.

daily.title: 'Alarming': Report says North Korean overseas labour financing nuclear weapons
daily.summary: Tens of thousands of North Korean labourers working in Russia and China reportedly raised as much as $US800 million last year for Kim Jong Un's nuclear weapons program, helping Pyongyang evade UN sanctions.

daily.title: Court battle looms for Socceroos star after drug test
daily.summary: Cristian Volpato is set for a court battle as the Socceroos star's lawyer confirms he will challenge charges that he was driving with cocaine in his system.

daily.title: Schools grappling with class 'splitting' as union flags industrial action
daily.summary: A nationwide teacher shortage affecting the ACT is causing huge teacher workloads and disrupting learning, as the union calls on the government to step up its pay and conditions offer.

daily.title: Record jail sentence for Israeli money launderer after Sydney trial
daily.summary: Shabtay Yaacoby, 56, was sentenced today for laundering more than $50 million in scam funds.

daily.title: With eight words, Tony Burke may have handed his opponents a campaign ad
daily.summary: It's possible that with eight words about migration, Tony Burke has handed his political opponents a campaign ad — and another reason not to reach a legislative compromise.

daily.title: Police arrest three men in Wadeye over stolen Darwin RAAF base vehicle
daily.summary: Northern Territory Police have found a Ford Ranger hundreds of kilometres away after it was stolen from a Royal Australian Airforce base in Darwin earlier this week and arrested three men.

daily.title: Nearly 1,700 sea dragons reported dead during SA's algal bloom
daily.summary: Dragon Search SA has studied reports of dead sea dragons made during the state's harmful algal bloom amid hopes of boosting numbers as breeding season nears.

daily.title: Universities and students alarmed by immigration crackdown on families
daily.summary: Higher education stakeholders say sweeping migration changes will jeopardise an export industry worth $55 billion, with international students likely to choose other destinations.

daily.title: Man accused of attacking two boys had 40 police 'involvements', court hears
daily.summary: Prosecutors said those interactions included a string of incidents in which the man was accused of assaulting young children and threatening staff at a primary school.

daily.title: Reza Pahlavi accepts Coalition invitation to visit Australia
daily.summary: The exiled son of Iran's last shah says he wants to be a "bridge" to democracy in Iran, not a candidate to lead the country.

daily.title: Coal-fired power needed to bolster $32bn Qld data centre, Nationals MP says
daily.summary: Nationals MP David Littleproud is backing more coal-fired power stations and nuclear energy to underpin the enormous energy requirements of a $32bn data centre.

developing.title: Live: ASX recovers from three-month low, surging oil prices drag Wall Street lower
developing.summary: The Australian share market has risen slightly, though is still trading near its lowest level since mid-June. Wall Street extended its sell-off as oil prices spiked on further signs of disruption in Saudi Arabian crude supplies. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Burke to unveil Labor's revamped migration policy tomorrow after delay
developing.summary: Tony Burke will announce Labor's highly anticipated migration overhaul tomorrow, a month after he was forced to postpone a planned address. Follow live.

developing.title: Breaking: Emergency warning for fire at Blackmore, west of Berry Springs
developing.summary: Bushfires Northern Territory have issued an emergency warning for a fire at Stockwell Road in Blackmore, west of Berry Springs.

developing.title: Breaking: Olympic authorities sign off on controversial rowing and canoeing venue
developing.summary: The Fitzroy River in Rockhampton will host the events despite concerns over its current, length and crocodile inhabitants.

developing.title: Live: RBA more likely to raise rates as US Federal Reserve lifts to 4pc
developing.summary: Markets are pricing in a nearly 90 per cent chance of Australia's reserve bank lifting interest rates in September following the US Federal Reserve's decision to hike rates.

developing.title: Live: Labor folds to pressure, scraps $5,000 veterans allied health cap
developing.summary: The federal government has bowed to pressure and scrapped its proposed $5,000 veteran allied health cap announced in this year's federal budget. Follow live.
